name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph featuring accelerated early 10-hand workforce scaling, unblocked Day 30 town shop contract delivery, dynamic zero-animal feed reserves, price-elasticity paced batch liquidation, and strict Day 25 seed cutoff.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under strict price floors while protecting animal feed and shop contracts.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into workforce acceleration (10-hand rush), contiguous land expansion, commercial high-yield seeds, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: harvest ready crops, worker drop-offs, watering, livestock feeding, planting, and ground maintenance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; satisfy payroll deficits first through immediate Town Shop contract deliveries (2.0x-3.5x premium) if deliverable inventory exists; only execute emergency open-market liquidation of non-feed inventory at hour >= 20 if payroll remains uncovered.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (0 if n_animals == 0 else max(3, n_animals * 3)); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and ((shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 and day <= 30) or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due + 50.0 and day <= 25))
attributes.guidance: Prioritize direct town shop deliveries of mature shed inventory to capture 2.0x-3.5x price premiums before fulfilling open market orders; allocate up to 3 order slots for fulfillment through Day 30; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) during days <= 25 whenever surplus cash covers midnight payroll reserve plus seed costs.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.20x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds after day 25 whose growth cycle exceeds remaining days; never divert produce allocated for active town shop delivery to open-market liquidation.

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute orderly batch sales (3-5 units per step to observe price elasticity) of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.75 * base_price; relax price floor to 0.50 * base_price only if shed_used >= 95 or during Day 29-30 terminal clearance to monetize all harvested assets.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell below 0.50 * base_price during transient shed spikes; never liquidate Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (0 if n_animals == 0 else max(3, n_animals * 3)); never evict produce allocated for active town shop fulfillment.

attributes.condition: (oracle_glut_risk >= 0.20 and current_price >= 0.70 * base_price) or (current_price >= 1.15 * base_price and shed_used >= 25)
attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute measured batch sales (3-4 items per step to respect price elasticity limits) of vulnerable or peak-priced commodities while market prices remain favorable (>= 0.70 * base_price for glut front-running, >= 1.15 * base_price for peak arbitrage) before opponent supply influx crashes market value.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.55 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts; pace order volume to avoid self-inflicted price depreciation.

attributes.condition: (hired_hands < 10 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 120.0 and day <= 20) or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.35 + 200.0 and (uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 25)
attributes.guidance: Prioritize rapid workforce acceleration to reach the 10-hand cap by day 8-12; purchase contiguous land plots only when workforce has surplus watering capacity; procure high-margin commercial seeds (Pumpkins, Tomatoes, Strawberries) and fertilizer during days <= 25 to maximize per-plot harvest yield.
attributes.pitfalls: Never hire hands after day 20 when wages cannot be recouped; never purchase long-growth seeds (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) after day 24 that cannot mature before day 30; do not acquire land plots that hands cannot consistently water; halt all expansion after day 25 to maximize terminal cash accumulation.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Harvest mature crops; 2) Drop off carried items at shed; 3) Water dry crops; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Plant commercial seeds; 6) Weed clearing and ground tilling. Ensure all carried inventory is deposited at shed by step 716 for terminal liquidation; prioritize watering planted plots with shortest time-to-maturity in late game.
attributes.pitfalls: Never prioritize weeding over harvesting or watering; do not leave mature crops unharvested across multi-step windows; ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain; never plant seeds after day 25 if time-to-maturity exceeds remaining game days.
